controls.normal_strength: Inherited G1 microrelief strength; does not change shape or collision.
controls.frame_shade: Inherited G1 frame shade, now also distinguishes existing timber rails.
controls.end_normal_threshold: Selects cut map where the normal faces along the timber member; no endgrain blend onto long faces.
controls.board_width_m: Inherited quarter metre D1/D3 physical board spacing; variation follows the same run across coarse/fine joins.
controls.board_phase_texels: Adjacent physical boards shift longitudinal grain by this whole-texel step within the original 1024-pixel face tile.
controls.face_resolution_px: Original D4 map size used to keep phase shifts on whole texels.
controls.recess_min_m: Minimum measured inward skin depth that receives protected metal seam response.
controls.recess_edge_guard_m: Keeps protected seam patina away from outer arrises; no added geometric seam.
controls.door_rails_y_m: Existing D2 horizontal rail centres; material orientation follows the retained geometry.
controls.door_rail_half_width_m: Existing D2 half width between strap grooves.
controls.coarse_rail_width_m: Existing D1 end-rail width on cube and wall; rail grain runs horizontally.
controls.fine_rail_width_m: Existing D3 half cube/wall rail width; does not scale texture density.
controls.panel_frame_width_m: Existing native/D3 integral panel batten width; frame orientation only.
controls.window_frame_width_m: Existing native/D3 opaque window frame width; no body or pane change.
controls.seam_roughness_add: Additional roughness at protected existing metal recesses; oxide/patina remains distinct from the metal body.
controls.projection_axis_threshold: Stabilizes near-axis broad-plane projection across existing bevel normals.
controls.roof_face_min_up: Separates roof covering planes from cut side/underside faces.
controls.alternate_axis_threshold: Selects a nonparallel tangent reference for end maps.
controls.recess_face_threshold: Limits protected metal seam tint to front-facing recesses.
controls.inspection_grid_m: Diagnostic grid pitch in metres; used only in labelled UV evidence.
controls.inspection_line_fraction: Diagnostic grid line fraction; not enabled in normal candidate rendering.
